title.narrative: Uttar Pradesh Power Distribution Network Rehabilitation Project – Tranche 1

description.narrative: The proposed Project will improve the quality and reliability of electricity supply, reduce the aggregate technical and commercial (ATC) losses in electricity distribution and restore the financial sustainability of the rural electricity supply. The Project will convert the low voltage distribution lines to aerial bundle conductors (ABC), separate the 11 kilovolt (kV) feeders supplying agriculture and rural households to facilitate the rationing of electricity supply to agriculture consumers, increase the supply duration to rural households and enhance the community engagement for improving electricity supply cost recovery and gender inclusivity in electricity distribution related activities in rural areas.

title.narrative: Loan 4025: 84% of contracts awarded and 70% disbursed as of 24 Apr 2025
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Sep 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51395/51395-003-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51395/51395-003-smr-en_5.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1.ADB funded feeder separation works in DVVNL and PVVNL are completed. ADB funded AB cabling work in PuVVNL and MVVNL are completed. 2.a. bill collection mechanism implemented, and blueprints prepared for four innovative bill collection strategies involving women as bill collector; b. 1,018 individual bill collection including 846 females and 172 males from Self Help Group (SHG), and those operating Common Service Centers (CSC), Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS), Public Distribution Shops (PDS) were trained on new bill collection methods; c.1,018 individual bill collection agents from SHGs, and those operating CSCs, PACS, PDS employed with UPPCL and 4 DISCOMs through various umbrella agencies, and actively collecting payment for electricity bills; d. Package of intervention for (i) Gender and Social Inclusion capacity building, (ii) guidelines for gender responsive human resource policies (iii) steps to enhance employability of women in various functions, developed and disseminated to 10 contractors.
